answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the shale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the comet of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
